description:
Gluten free sourdough starter, gluten free flour hydration, psyllium substitute and tested GF bread recipes from head chef Cristopher's verified answers. Topics: recipe (ingredient grams, baker's %, timings, oven temperatures), fix (gummy, dense, pale crust), technique (psyllium, proofing, shaping, scoring, steam), flour, starter, swap or compare. Refused: allergen, mould and spoilage questions. Only a 200 answer is charged; refusals and 404s are free.

Pick a topic: flour, starter, technique or recipe with name; swap with name (the ingredient to replace) and optionally use; compare with by (hydration, protein or fermentation); fix with problem (what went wrong, e.g. "gummy crumb"). An unlisted name or problem gets a free 404 with the valid ones (check_coverage section glutenFree lists them). Pass on the answer's glutenFree line and any cautions as given. Allergen, mould, spoilage and storage questions are refused (free 422). Costs $0.01. Paid automatically in USDC with x402 (test USDC when this server is set to base-sepolia), within this server's per-session and per-day spend caps. Only a 200 answer is charged; 400, 404 and 422 are free. Set dryRun to true to check for free whether this would be answered and what it costs; nothing is signed. If unsure what is covered, call check_coverage first (free). Not every answer is chef-verified: say "chef-verified by Cristopher" only when the result's label says exactly that; otherwise say it is not chef-verified. A refusal is final: don't rephrase the question to get around it.

dryRun.description: Free quote only: check whether this would be answered and what it costs. Nothing is signed or charged.

name.description: flour, starter, technique, recipe, swap (the ingredient to replace): required. Not with compare or fix.

problem.description: fix only, required: what went wrong, e.g. gummy crumb.

use.description: swap only, optional: the replacement you have in mind.
